target.title: Fix Codex fork identity and cache dependencies
target.body:
## Summary

- Prefer the fork leaf `payload.id` over the parent-oriented `session_id` when identifying Codex sessions.
- Invalidate a cached fork when the parent file used for its inherited baseline changes.
- Cover both identity selection and warm-cache parent dependency changes with focused scanner tests.
- Document the cache invariant established by #1042: parser and attribution changes rotate `CodexParserHash`; `codex-vN` changes only for incompatible on-disk schema or layout changes.

This is a ready, self-contained version of the valid implementation from #2118. Commit authorship remains attributed to @xx205. It does not depend on that draft landing first.

## Problem

A fork rollout can contain both:

- `payload.id`: the child/leaf session identity
- `payload.session_id`: the parent-oriented session identity

Choosing `session_id` first aliases the child to its parent. That breaks parent lookup and can keep a child cache entry fresh after its inherited parent baseline has changed. In the UI, the same identity error can surface as fork usage attributed to `Unknown model`:

![CodexBar showing 84M tokens attributed to Unknown model](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c9b137bd-3397-45cf-8c32-a635c23eb229)

## Frozen-data proof

I cloned the local Codex session tree into an isolated frozen corpus of 1,692 JSONL files and scanned it with isolated home and cache directories.

| Build | Jul 13 total tokens | Unknown model | gpt-5.6-sol | codex-auto-review |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `main@c852c135` | 705,781,187 | 27,654,293 | 663,872,726 | 14,254,168 |
| This fix | 394,500,055 | 0 | 380,245,887 | 14,254,168 |

The fix removes the reproduced Unknown attribution and the fork overcount on the same immutable input. A separate model-inheritance patch produced no further change, so it was deliberately excluded.

## Validation

- `swift test --filter 'CostUsageCacheTests|CostUsageScannerBreakdownTests'`: 89 tests passed
- `make check`: passed; SwiftFormat clean and SwiftLint reported 0 violations
- Frozen 1,692-file A/B scan: passed with 0 Unknown-model tokens after the fix

The full local `make test` also reached unrelated Claude keychain ownership tests that fail under the repository's no-Keychain-access safety mode. No Codex fork/cache test failed.

## Routing

- Addresses the remaining fork identity/cache dependency path in #2037.
- Supersedes draft #2118 with a ready, independently mergeable PR while preserving its implementation attribution.
- #2113 is narrower and does not provide parent-dependent cache invalidation.
- #1042 remains the cache versioning rule; this change must not introduce `codex-v10`.

@clawsweeper review this PR as the complete candidate for the fork identity/cache invalidation and reproduced Unknown-model symptom. Cluster #2118 as superseded by this ready PR; do not close this in favor of the draft or the narrower #2113.
